1606 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
05-30 to end of May: 1 day (May 31).  
June (30) + July (31) + August (31) + September (30) + October (31) + November (30) + December (31) = 214 days from June 1 to Dec 31.  
From 05-30, days remaining in 1606 = 1 + 214 = 215 days.  
222 - 215 = 7 days into 1607.  
1607-01-01 + 7 days = 1607-01-08.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1607-01-08
